canonical_name: Recovery Actions Not Selected, Scoped, Prioritized, and Performed
description: Recovery actions are not selected, scoped, prioritized, and performed.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with business continuity and disaster recovery requirements Incident recovery and restoration teams Communications and public relations functions Organizations with regulatory recovery requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify recovery efforts that lack documented selection criteria, scope definition, or prioritization frameworks. Monitor for random or reactive recovery actions without clear business impact analysis or sequencing based on critical function dependencies.
